svg.text: ① sign in once and stay signed in · ② find and save a job · ③ tailor your CV · ④ let your inbox move the pipeline
① Sign in once, stay signed in
all of it inside the Dio interceptor, no screen code
② Find a job and save it
same search engine as the web app
the work runs on the server, the phone stays light
only extracted facts are stored, never the e-mail text
